AMD FidelityFX / FSR SDK API headers (MIT, see the notice in each file), unchanged from
https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/FidelityFX-SDK tag v2.4.0, Kits/FidelityFX/{api,framegeneration}/include.
Only what frame generation needs (las/nvn/vulkan/framegen.c). The signed DLLs are not here: tools/fidelityfx
(amd_fidelityfx_loader_vk.dll, amd_fidelityfx_framegeneration_vk.dll from Kits/FidelityFX/signedbin).
